text:
alex: FYI — acme-inc reports ~200-400ms extra latency. Traces show requests served from us-east even though their app sets region=\"eu\" in the POST body. Suspect our edge is parsing Accept-Language and forcing US routing.

alex: Example repro (minimal):
```bash
curl -v 
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <redacted>\" 
  -H \"Accept-Language: fr-FR, en-US;q=0.8\" 
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" 
  -d '{"region":"eu","input":"hello"}' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

maria: can you paste the raw edge header log for one of the requests? need to see exactly what the router saw.

alex: pasted the edge log for request_id=req_8a7f: 
```
timestamp=2025-03-12T15:04:02Z edge=edge-12 request_id=req_8a7f headers={Authorization:Bearer xxxxx, Accept-Language:fr-FR, en-US;q=0.8, Content-Type:application/json, Host:api.redwood.ai} body={"region":"eu","input":"hello"}
```

infra-bot: router=route-decider selected_region=US reason=\"parsed_locale=en-US from Accept-Language\" request_id=req_8a7f

sam: that matches a bug I saw in the locale parser — it naively extracts the country subtag from the first matching token and doesn't check for an explicit region header or body param. if Accept-Language contains any US tag it can end up winning.

ingrid: immediate mitigation: stop using Accept-Language for routing. precedence should be: X-Client-Region header -> explicit region param/JWT claim -> configured account default -> Accept-Language (last resort). I'll push an edge flag to disable locale-based routing.

maria: support action: tell customer to set `X-Client-Region: eu-west-1` as a short-term workaround. i'll draft an email + KB and notify their TAM.

alex: repro steps I used: 1) run curl above 2) check edge log shows selected_region=US 3) add header `-H \"X-Client-Region: eu-west-1\"` and rerun -> routed to eu-west successfully.

sam: i'll open a small PR to change precedence and add unit tests for Accept-Language parsing. will include a guard so locale parsing only applies when no explicit region is present.

ingrid: hotfix plan: flip edge flag to ignore Accept-Language for routing (staging first) -> monitor 30m -> prod roll. ETA ~45m. i'll post status updates here.

maria: tagging CS: @alex i'll coordinate customer comms once ingrid confirms prod rollout.

alex: thanks everyone — this explains the sudden cross-region latency spike. pls keep thread updated. :pray:
